item.title: Spark On Yarn: yarn-cluster, yarn-client
item.description: YARN is a generic resource-management framework for distributed workloads; in other words, a cluster-level operating system. Although part of the Hadoop ecosystem, YARN can support a lot of varied compute-frameworks (such as Tez, and Spark) in addition to MapReduce.
